modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sabercraf: Turns the netherite sword into a cinematic energy saber.
sabercraft.customize.title: Customize saber
sabercraft.customize.unsupported: On this server only possible in creative mode, because SaberCraft is not installed there.
sabercraft.hilt.standard.description: The plain, flat hilt of the first version.
sabercraft.hilt.guardian.description: Classic silver hilt with black grip ridges and a clamp, in the style of an order knight.
sabercraft.hilt.dark_lord.description: Black hilt with silver ribs, red buttons and a toothed emitter. Ignites heavier and hums deeper.
sabercraft.hilt.sentinel.description: Black and silver hilt with a wrapped grip and a vented emitter.
sabercraft.hilt.double.description: Experimental: long hilt with a blade at each end. Both blades ignite together.
sabercraft.style.flowing.description: Quick, flowing cuts in a combo of diagonal, backhand, rising and overhead strikes. A stab while sprinting. Dodges with rolls.
sabercraft.style.heavy.description: Slow, powerful blows from a high stance. A strong thrust while sprinting. Dodges with side steps, forward with a deep lunge.
sabercraft.style.staff.description: Wide sweeps with both blades and turns around the body. The special key starts the blade whirl in front of the body.
sabercraft.ability.no_saber: Ignite a saber in your main hand first.
sabercraft.ability.no_server: Abilities need SaberCraft on the server.
sabercraft.style.defensive.description: Low, wide stance with short, economical cuts close to the body. Longer parry window, blocks hold more and cost less stamina. Slower dodges.
sabercraft.style.agile.description: Blade held high, fast springy cuts with turns, hops and a flip. Quick, cheap dodges, but weaker blocks.
sabercraft.menu.combat.title: Combat, powers and keys
sabercraft.menu.combat.note: What a power does, its cooldown and its stamina cost are decided by the server (config/sabercraft/abilities.json). Here you set what only affects your game.
sabercraft.menu.space.title: Space sky
sabercraft.menu.space.note: Stars, nebulae, galaxies, planets and moons instead of the plain night sky, different in every dimension. Only in your game; off = the normal Minecraft sky. With an Iris shader pack it stays off unless you allow it.
sabercraft.menu.music.title: Music
sabercraft.menu.music.note: Original pieces for exploring, night, combat and special moments, with smooth transitions. Replaces the normal game music while it is on. Your own .ogg files go into config/sabercraft/music/<mood>/; only use music you are allowed to use.
sabercraft.menu.graphics.title: Graphics and effects
sabercraft.menu.graphics.note: Fewer particles and a lower sky quality help on slower computers. Sparks, light trails and power effects have fixed limits.
sabercraft.menu.character.title: Character
sabercraft.menu.character.take_saber.des: Gives the saber in your hand the hilt, color and fighting style that go with this outfit.
sabercraft.menu.character.saber_taken: The saber in your hand now matches the outfit.
sabercraft.option.combat_animations.desc: Own attack, defense and dodge animations instead of the normal swing.
sabercraft.option.ready_stance.descripti: Resting and defensive poses while a lit saber is held.
sabercraft.option.ability_hud.descriptio: Cooldowns and stamina next to the hotbar.
sabercraft.option.space_sky.description: The painted starry sky with planets instead of the normal night sky.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_quality.desc: Resolution of the sky: low 256, medium 512, high 1024 pixels per side. Painted in the background.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_in_end.descr: A space sky of its own in the End too, over the normal End sky.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_with_shaders: Show the sky even while an Iris shader pack is active. Shader packs usually draw their own sky.
sabercraft.option.music.description: Own music for the situation instead of the normal game music. Off = normal Minecraft music.
sabercraft.option.music_volume.descripti: Own volume of the SaberCraft music, on top of Minecraft's music slider.
sabercraft.option.music_crossfade.descri: How long one piece fades out and the next fades in.
sabercraft.option.music_user_files.descr: Also play your own .ogg files from config/sabercraft/music/.
sabercraft.option.blade_trails.descripti: A glowing trail behind the blade during fast movements.
sabercraft.option.trail_strength.descrip: How bright the light trail glows.
sabercraft.option.particles.description: Amount of sparks and power effects.
sabercraft.option.hide_vanilla_sweep.des: Hides Minecraft's white sweep arc next to sabers.
sabercraft.option.camera_motion.descript: How much the camera follows rolls and landings.
sabercraft.option.show_other_outfits.des: Show the outfits other players chose. Off: everyone else looks like their normal skin.
sabercraft.outfit.none.description: Just your normal Minecraft skin, no outfit.
sabercraft.outfit.wanderer.description: Light tunic, open brown robe, hood down. Calm and balanced.
sabercraft.outfit.shadow.description: Black robe with a crimson sash, the hood deep over the face.
sabercraft.outfit.sentinel.description: Silver plates over a dark green suit, shoulder pads and greaves.
sabercraft.outfit.scout.description: Light leather vest, yellow scarf, gloves and high boots. Made for agility.
sabercraft.outfit.twilight.description: Dark plate armor with violet light lines and a closed helmet.
sabercraft.outfit.file.description: Your own outfits: 64 x 64 PNG in the skin layout in config/sabercraft/outfits/. Only you see them, they are never sent.
